title: α-Fe 10 keV self-ion cascade (structural)
summary: BCC iron, 10³ cells, 300 K, one 10 keV Fe PKA. Uses the D–T scenario layout but the PKA is Fe — not the W default that used to leak in from the fuel preset.
warnings: Catalog slot fe-eam-placeholder is not a real potential — Submit dry-runs until you download/upload a cited α-Fe EAM/FS.
If you pick D–T on Scenario after loading this, Aegis remaps pka_species to Fe (host), but still copies T/energy/cell from the preset unless you re-load this example.
10 keV in 10³ (~2000 atoms) can wrap; treat Results as a workflow check, not a published residual-damage number.
user_walkthrough: Material: Iron (α-Fe) — PKA species must be Fe, not W.
Potential: Acquire Zhou04 Fe (or upload a cited file); avoid the placeholder for real MD.
Simulate: confirm pka_species=Fe, 10000 eV, 10×10×10, timestep 1 fs.
First run: mpi_procs=1. After Engines shows lmp MPI=likely, raise ranks.
Submit → Run → Results. Campaigns only after this single recipe finishes.
